# `mapConstToAs`

Suggests using Effect.as instead of Effect.map when the callback ignores its input and returns a constant

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377152` |
| Language Service name | `mapConstToAs` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/map-const-to-as` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)

export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))
/**
                                            ^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(map-const-to-as): `Effect.as` expresses replacing the success value with a constant directly.
*/
```
